p-adic Delsarte-Goethals-Seidel-Kabatianskii-Levenshtein-Pfender Bound
K. Mahesh Krishna
School of Mathematics and Natural Sciences

NH-648, Haraluru Village

Karnataka State, 562 110, India
Email: kmaheshak@gmail.com
Date: March 10, 2025
Abstract: We introduce the notion of p-adic spherical codes (in particular, p-adic kissing number
problem). We show that the one-line proof for a variant of the Delsarte-Goethals-Seidel-Kabatianskii-
Levenshtein upper bound for spherical codes, obtained by Pfender [J. Combin. Theory Ser. A, 2007],
extends to p-adic Hilbert spaces.
Keywords: Spherical code, Kissing number, Linear programming, p-adic Hilbert space.
Mathematics Subject Classiﬁcation (2020): 52C17, 12J25, 46S10, 11D88.

Fundamental problem associated with spherical codes is the following.

The case θ = π/3 is known as the famous (Newton-Gregory) kissing number problem.
